text:
The response is relevant and provides five well-known documentaries with concise descriptions, which is helpful for aspiring filmmakers. However, it contains several factual inaccuracies about awards: “13th” did not win the cited Sundance award, “Blackfish” was not nominated for an Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature and did not win the Sundance Audience Award, and “Hoop Dreams” was nominated for Best Film Editing, not Best Documentary Feature. These errors reduce the reliability of the answer.

Rating: [[5]]
